name: Multimodal fusion
input: text embedding (frozen transformer) + 12 profile stats + interaction graph

performance.reference_how: best test AUC in the models that read the same inputs (GCN)

checks.name: accuracy
checks.detail: Test AUC 0.948 vs reference 0.965, the best test AUC in the models that read the same inputs (GCN); needs at least 0.905.

checks.name: generalises
checks.detail: Validation AUC 0.999, test AUC 0.948 (drop 0.051; at most 0.05 allowed).

checks.name: right_reasons
checks.detail: Block Shapley values follow the planted signal for text (0.77) and account stats (0.76); graph block separates ring members with AUC 0.51 (needs 0.50, 0.50 and 0.70).

strengths.text: Accurate: test AUC 0.948, within 0.016 of the reference 0.965.
Its text evidence tracks the planted marker words (rank correlation 0.77).
Its account-stat evidence tracks the true formula (rank correlation 0.76).

weaknesses.text: Learned something that did not carry over: AUC falls from 0.999 on validation to 0.948 on test.
Its graph evidence does not single out troll rings (AUC 0.51, 0.50 = chance).
Mostly a text model: text alone reaches AUC 0.87 of its full 0.95.
Block Shapley is not faithful: removing what it calls important changes the score barely more than removing random inputs.

checklist.text: Test on data collected after your training data. Behaviour drifts, and a validation split from the same period hides that.
Choose the decision threshold on held-out data for the precision you need; a wrongly banned real user costs more than a missed bot.
Keep a fixed audit sample of labelled accounts and re-run the explanations on it after every retrain.
List which inputs an attacker can change cheaply (posting rate, hashtags, timing) and test the model with those changed.
Find the feature that stopped working between validation and test (here, likely #trending) and remove it or retrain without it.
checklist.because: Learned something that did not carry over: AUC falls from 0.999 on validation to 0.948 on test.

checklist.text: Check coordinated groups separately; this model's graph evidence does not reveal them.
checklist.because: Its graph evidence does not single out troll rings (AUC 0.51, 0.50 = chance).

checklist.text: Test with the text signal weakened (paraphrased or disguised words); the other inputs may not catch up.

checklist.text: Run a deletion test (remove the top-ranked inputs, watch the score) before trusting this method.
